preregistration.expectation: Killing a process mid-write inside an owned worktree, then running Worktrunk's closest cleanup primitive (`wt step prune`), will preserve the dirty/crash-leftover files and leave an unrelated (master) worktree untouched, since prune only removes worktrees merged into the default branch.
preregistration.criteria: File presence and worktree listing recorded before and after `wt step prune` on a repo containing one dirty, unmerged, crash-interrupted worktree plus the unrelated main worktree.
